item.title: Claude Opus 5.5 Ports Three.js 3D Scene to Vanilla WebGL
item.description:
Developer Simon Willison used Claude Opus 5.5 in a standard chat session to port a Three.js 3D scene into dependency-free vanilla JavaScript and WebGL, with both versions rendering successfully. It is an anecdotal hands-on demo showing the model can rewrite 3D graphics code across libraries, but offers no quantitative benchmark or reproducible methodology.

原文标题：Claude Opus 5.5 将 Three.js 3D 场景改写为原生 WebGL

Why it matters：一则直观的模型能力实测，展示 Claude 在 3D 图形代码改写上的实用性，适合关注 LLM 编码能力的读者快速参考。

Simon Willison 博客 · llm · signal 42/100

item.title: Tuck Verbose AI-Written PR Descriptions Behind a details Tag
item.description:
The author argues that PR descriptions written by Claude Code and Codex, while accurate and comprehensive, read like slop due to information overload and trigger an instinctive refusal to read. He advocates keeping human editorial judgment with a short human-approved intro, and hiding the verbose AI description behind a \u003cdetails\u003e tag to reduce reading burden.

原文标题：用 details 标签折叠 AI 生成的冗长 PR 描述

Why it matters：这是一条关于 AI 编码代理工作流中信息过载问题的实用经验，对日常使用 Claude Code 与 Codex 的开发者有直接参考价值。

Simon Willison 博客 · tools · signal 42/100

item.title: Drought and Data Center Water Use Trigger Tap Water Crisis in Batam, Indonesia
item.description:
Batam, Indonesia, a key Southeast Asian hub for AI data centers, is facing a tap water crisis as prolonged drought and El Niño deplete reservoirs while water-intensive cooling systems at some facilities add pressure, sparking protests. Authorities have ordered operators to build their own desalination plants, and some firms have pledged closed-loop water cooling.

原文标题：干旱叠加数据中心耗水，印尼峇淡暴发自来水危机

Why it matters：揭示 AI 算力扩张与地方水资源之间的现实冲突，是数据中心可持续性议题的典型案例。

IT之家 · IT业界 · compute · signal 58/100

item.title: Critique Argues GPUI and egui State Models Won't Scale to Complex Desktop Apps
item.description:
The author argues that the state models of GPUI and egui are dead ends for complex desktop applications: the frameworks cannot determine what changed and who depends on it, forcing the application layer to declare it by hand and sacrificing the API semantics that made them attractive. The post acknowledges both excel in contexts like Zed and bevy debug UIs, but opposes treating them as the default choice for native desktop apps.

原文标题：长文批评 GPUI 与 egui 状态模型难撑复杂桌面应用

Why it matters：对 Rust 原生 GUI 框架架构取舍的深度技术批评，涉及 Discord 重写等真实案例，对关注桌面端 AI 应用技术选型的开发者有参考价值。

item.title: Anthropic Study Finds Scientists Mainly Use Claude for Data Analysis and Writing
item.description:
Anthropic published a report based on 207,000 research sessions and a survey of 528 scientists, finding that data analysis (33.7% of research sessions) and writing (32%) dominate scientific use of Claude, while data collection and hypothesis generation lag well behind. Computer science, math and statistics show the highest usage density, and AI/ML researchers—just 1.2% of the global total—account for 15.2% of Claude Code research sessions.

原文标题：Anthropic 研究：科学家主要用 Claude 做数据分析与写作

Why it matters：首份基于大规模真实会话数据的 AI 科研使用画像，揭示 AI 在科研流程中的实际渗透边界。

IT之家 · 智能时代 · industry · signal 62/100

item.title: Shenzhen 3D Printer Exports Jump 127.5%, Taking 86% of China's Total
item.description:
Shenzhen's 3D printer output rose 58.1% year on year in the first half of 2026, with exports up 127.5% and accounting for 86% of China's total shipments of the category, earning it the unofficial title of the world's top consumer 3D printing hub. Four local firms — Bambu Lab, Creality, Anycubic and Elegoo — together hold roughly 90% of global consumer-grade shipments, and Bambu Lab has begun building a Guangming district base targeting annual capacity above 3 million units.

原文标题：深圳上半年 3D 打印出口增 127.5% 占全国八成六

Why it matters：这是中国消费级 3D 打印产业链集中度与出口数据的权威披露，对关注硬件制造与开源硬件生态的读者有参考价值。

IT之家 · IT业界 · industry · signal 52/100

item.title: JIC to Sell JSR to Mitsui Chemicals and DBJ in $12B-Plus Deal
item.description:
Japan Investment Corporation (JIC) announced it will sell JSR, the world's second-largest photoresist maker, to Mitsui Chemicals and the Development Bank of Japan, valuing JSR's equity at ¥1.3921 trillion and the total deal at over ¥1.8 trillion including assumed debt, with closing expected in the second half of fiscal 2027. JSR will become a Mitsui Chemicals consolidated subsidiary, broadening Mitsui's semiconductor materials portfolio, while JSR's life sciences unit and Mitsui's mobility business are marked as non-core for divestiture.

原文标题：JIC 将 JSR 出售给三井化学与 DBJ 交易额超 1.8 万亿日元

Why it matters：半导体光刻胶关键供应商易主，直接牵动全球芯片材料供应链格局，值得算力与产业读者关注。

item.title: Trump Says AI Risks Are Manageable, Open to Regulatory Guardrails
item.description:
President Trump said AI risks are manageable and that he does not mind setting regulatory guardrails, signaling willingness to work with Democrats on oversight. The remark marks a shift from his earlier support for industry self-regulation and his dismissal of AI safety concerns as a hoax, though the extent of his openness remains unclear.

原文标题：特朗普称 AI 风险可控 对设置监管护栏持开放态度

Why it matters：美国 AI 监管风向可能出现边际变化，但仅有表态、缺乏具体政策细节，值得关注而非重点跟进。

item.title: LG AI Research Opens K-EXAONE 2.5 Model API for Free
item.description:
LG AI Research has made its K-EXAONE 2.5 model API freely available to developers, enterprises, and research institutions at no cost. The model, further trained from the August release, shows agentic capabilities on par with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and GLM-5.3 across AutomationBench, SWE-Bench Pro, BrowseComp, and Claw-Eval.

原文标题：LG AI 研究院免费开放 K-EXAONE 2.5 模型 API

Why it matters：免费开放 API 降低了使用门槛，且模型在多个智能体基准上对标头部开源模型，值得关注。

item.title: DeepMind Economist: Growth May Stay at 4-5% Even With Millions of AI Agents
item.description:
Alex Imas, Director of AGI Economics at Google DeepMind, argues that even with millions of autonomous AI agents, economic growth could remain in the 4-5% range. His core reasoning: GDP measures dollars spent rather than physical output, and when AI makes goods nearly free to produce, competition drives prices down, so output can explode while its dollar value barely grows, much like farming falling from ~40% to 2% of GDP after automation despite soaring food production.

原文标题：DeepMind 经济学家：即便有数百万 AI 智能体，经济增长仍可能停留在 4% 至 5%

Why it matters：来自 DeepMind 经济学负责人的反直觉判断，为 AI 生产力叙事提供了 GDP 度量视角的重要修正。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · industry · signal 58/100

item.title: Trump Says US Can't Finish Second to China in AI, Backs Guardrails
item.description:
In a 60 Minutes interview, President Trump said the US cannot afford to fall behind China in AI, voicing support for guardrails while warning against regulation that would drop America to second place. He claimed China has no guardrails. No concrete policy details were disclosed.

Why it matters：这是 AI 地缘竞争与监管取向的高层表态，但缺乏具体政策内容，仅具信号意义。

item.title: AMD CEO Lisa Su Says Meta Muse Hit 10M Users in 45 Days
item.description:
AMD CEO Lisa Su cited Meta's Muse as a standout example of rapid AI adoption, noting over 10 million activations in 45 days. She said annual operating plans that were once fixed now shift month to month because of AI adoption.

item.title: Cathie Wood Says Official Inflation Data Understates AI-Driven Software Price Deflation
item.description:
ARK Invest CEO Cathie Wood argues that AI training and inference costs are falling 75% to 99% annually, yet official inflation gauges such as CPI and PPI fail to capture how fast software prices are actually declining. The claim is a macro-level assertion without a disclosed methodology or data source.

原文标题：木头姐：官方通胀数据低估了 AI 压低软件价格的速度

Why it matters：这是知名投资人关于 AI 通缩效应的宏观观点，对关注 AI 产业经济影响的读者有参考价值，但缺乏可验证数据。

item.description:

item.title: Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron and SEMI Discuss Robot Charging Standardization for Fabs
item.description:
Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix and Micron are in talks with SEMI to standardize robot charging systems inside wafer fabs, forming an RX (Robot Transformation) alliance. The group will first ensure structural compatibility of charging equipment, then link robot battery data to fab manufacturing execution systems to coordinate work and charging schedules, addressing space constraints and fragmented charging specs in older fabs.

原文标题：三星、SK 海力士、美光与 SEMI 磋商晶圆厂机器人充电标准化

Why it matters：这是半导体制造自动化与机器人基础设施标准化的早期动向，虽处磋商阶段，但对晶圆厂智能化与机器人部署有长期影响。

item.title: Gurman: Apple May Launch Agentic Siri as Early as Next Year
item.description:
Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports in Power On that Apple plans to ship an autonomous, agentic Siri as early as next year, shifting from command-response to proactively managing tasks and acting on the user's behalf against ChatGPT Dots, Meta Muse and Grok. The report also says new CEO John Ternus has pressed software chief Craig Federighi to accelerate Apple's AI efforts.

item.title: Artificial Analysis Releases Decision Index v2 with Calibrated Confidence Metric
item.description:
Artificial Analysis launched Decision Index v2, raising private-dataset coverage from 25% to 45% and introducing a Decision Score that rewards both correctness and calibrated confidence. Drex Max v1.1 leads narrowly at 73, just ahead of GLiDE v1.2 and Mammoth 27B, while GPT-6 Luna (Max) scores higher but costs $1,530 per 1M tasks and runs ~40x slower.

原文标题：Artificial Analysis 发布决策指数 v2 引入校准置信度新指标

Why it matters：第三方评测机构更新核心榜单方法论，直接影响模型选型与基准可信度判断。

item.title: Opinion: The AI Bubble Narrative May Be Overstated
item.description:
The author argues that despite at least $3 trillion in spending commitments and opaque financing vehicles, the assumption that an AI bubble must pop is not well founded, and rapid growth may still be justified. The piece is opinion analysis without new verifiable data or quantitative modeling.

Why it matters：提供对 AI 泡沫争论的反向视角，适合关注行业估值与资本开支的读者参考。

item.title: Stanford and DeepMind's TURTLE Evolves Tool-Use Benchmarks to Stay Hard
item.description:
A new Stanford and Google DeepMind paper introduces TURTLE, which uses AlphaEvolve to mutate saturated tool-use tasks from AppWorld by adding filters, extra steps and hidden lookups, targeting roughly 50% solver success. Gemma 4 31B-it always solved 69% of original tasks, while nearly all 735 evolved tasks landed at 40%-60% completion, and an LLM judge rated 52.5% of evolved tasks hard versus 19.8% of originals.

原文标题：斯坦福与 DeepMind 提出 TURTLE 自动进化工具调用基准

Why it matters：提出一种可复用的基准自动进化范式，直接回应工具调用评测饱和问题，对关注模型评测与智能体的读者有实操价值。

item.title: 腾讯元器正式停服 明年 1 月起停止受理数据导出
item.description:
腾讯一站式智能体平台“元器”于 11 月 9 日正式停止全部公众服务，已发布至公众号、微信客服等渠道的智能体同步失效。用户须在 2027 年 1 月 9 日前完成数据导出，此后官方将删除全部用户数据；腾讯引导用户迁移至腾讯云智能体开发平台（ADP）与公众号智能回复。

Why it matters：大厂智能体平台退场，反映智能体分发赛道的整合与洗牌，对关注 Agent 生态的读者有参考价值。

item.title: KetchUp 发布 Rust 与 WebGPU 打造的开源 SketchUp 替代品
item.description:
KetchUp 是一款面向木工与家具设计的免费开源 3D 建模应用，采用 Rust 编写并基于 WebGPU 渲染，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux 及桌面浏览器，无需账号即可使用。它主打精确尺寸的板材、桌柜与工作台规划，定位为 SketchUp 的轻量替代方案，但纹理、场景及部分模型功能尚不支持，OBJ 导出不含材质。

Why it matters：这是 WebGPU 与 Rust 在桌面级 3D 建模工具中的一次实用落地，对关注开源图形工具链的开发者有参考价值。

item.title: 用 C 与 Rust 编写 SQLite parse_number 扩展对比
item.description:
Simon Willison 借助 Claude 对比了用 C 与 Rust 实现 SQLite parse_number() 自定义函数的差异：C 版扩展仅 14 KB，Rust 版约 300 KB 但运行更快，原因是 Rust 的浮点解析实现比 C 的 strtod 快约一倍。作者随后尝试手写更快的 C 解析函数，并将整个过程整理为可复现的研究报告。

Why it matters：以具体体积与性能数据展示 C 与 Rust 编写 SQLite 扩展的取舍，对扩展开发者有直接参考价值。

Simon Willison 博客 · tools · signal 42/100

item.title: 斯坦福开设 AI 原生工程课 教开发者用智能体重构工作流
item.description:
斯坦福讲师 Mihail Eric 在访谈中介绍了其《现代软件开发者》课程的教学框架，核心是让软件工程师学会用编码智能体交付软件、排查线上故障，而非仅把 AI 当作补全工具。他还结合在 Monaco 带领 AI 团队的一线实践，说明了课程中哪些内容真正经受住了生产环境检验。

Why it matters：对关心工程师技能转型与智能体落地实践的读者有参考价值，但属访谈观点而非可验证的新技术发布。

item.title: SafeScript 发布：可安全执行不可信代码的 JavaScript 子集
item.description:
SafeScript 是 JavaScript 的严格安全子集，移除 eval、new、全局对象与原型访问，可编译为原生 JS 与 PHP，编译器仅约 48 KB（gzip 后约 12 KB）。它面向网页处理器、事件回调、插件脚本、公式表达式以及 AI 智能体可调用工具等场景，让用户提交的逻辑在沙箱内安全运行。

Why it matters：为不可信代码提供可本地验证的轻量安全执行层，对智能体工具与插件生态有直接实用价值。

item.title: 亚马逊论文发现规则类基准答案键与评分代码普遍出错
item.description:
亚马逊一篇新论文审计了 9 个公开的规则遵循类基准（如 RuleArena、LegalBench），发现其参考答案与评分代码本身存在错误，导致模型正确答案被误判。以 LegalBench 税务评分为例，评分器删除小数点，把 259,487.13 美元读成 25,948,713，修复后 3 个模型的通过数从 8-9/96 升至 87-91/96。作者建议在看到低分时先读评分代码并人工抽查失败样本。

Why it matters：该研究揭示规则类基准的评分缺陷会系统性低估模型能力，直接影响对模型评测结论的信任。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · llm · signal 71/100

item.description:
斯坦福 CS146S 课程在编码智能体可一键完成作业的背景下，改为让学生学习陌生开源仓库、提出修改并向可能合并补丁的维护者解释方案。授课人 Mihail Eric 同时负责 Monaco 的 AI 工作，他在访谈中展示了课程大纲，并分享了团队自建智能体工作区、采购代码审查工具、让值班智能体接入 Datadog 与 GitHub 的实践取舍。

Why it matters：提供了一个可借鉴的 AI 原生工程教学范式，以及企业自建与采购智能体工具的决策视角。

item.title: 用 Git 队列管理 AI 编码会话 缓解上下文过载
item.description:
